text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Nikkei Shinshun Hai. Trying to break free from her half-hearted self, Mejiro Palmer shows her party girl side in full force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd is in an uproar. Boasting that she's going to win over all the fans still on the fence about her new party mood, she heads into the race.
